# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.92

This release introduces the first complete Buddy Rush playable loop: recruit
collectable Buddies, bring a clubhouse to life, defend Friendship Badges, and
visit friendly rival clubhouses in a safe offline neighbourhood.

## Buddy collection and clubhouse

- Added 12 collectable Buddies across six rarity tiers, four talents, and rare
  visual styles.
- Added the rotating Buddy Bus with deterministic offers, retry-friendly
  recruitment challenges, and consolation coins.
- Added the player clubhouse, three activity stations, passive and offline
  earnings, exclusive Favourite protection, and the BuddyBook.
- Added three rival clubhouses, four AI personalities, paired escape routes,
  relationship memory, neighbourhood progression, quests, badges, audio cues,
  minimap objectives, and contextual notices.

## Friendly Rush gameplay

- Added protected, warning, Rush, and recovery shield states.
- AI rivals can approach, capture an eligible Friendship Badge, escape with a
  visibly following Buddy, be tagged, and trigger a temporary visit and Rescue
  Quest without changing ownership or friendship.
- Players can hold to capture a rival badge, escort its Buddy home, and host a
  temporary visitor without leaving a duplicate at the rival clubhouse.
- Added Bubble Blaster, Buddy Whistle, and Roller Skates with cooldowns,
  visible spatial effects, movement changes, and route counterplay.
- Added Tracker Pup and Guard Bot pet roles plus Friendly, Standard, Reduced
  Tension, disable, and reduced-motion settings.

## Safety, saving, and performance

- Favourite Buddies cannot be captured, only one Buddy is involved per Rush,
  the same rival cannot raid twice consecutively, and failed defence makes the
  next chase easier.
- Added versioned migration, sanitisation, atomic backup saves, safe
  interruption recovery, automatic visit expiry, and stale rescue cleanup.
- Added multi-route navigation, 12-Buddy clubhouse, repeated live-Rush,
  long-session, save/resume, touch E2E, and mobile/desktop visual regression
  coverage.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.
